memory_search: ALWAYS call before answering anything personal, preferential, or project-specific. Searches durable memory. Returns ranked memories with age/use counts.
memory_save: Save ONE durable fact. Ephemeral/trivial input is rejected — do not retry it.
skill_sync: ALWAYS call first when starting any task. Returns the skill deltas (file harnesses) or the skill index bundle (web) you must consult before answering. Re-call with a filter when truncated.
memory_delete: Archive one memory by key (soft-delete; missing key is a no-op receipt).
skill_get: Fetch one skill body by name (version pins an old revision).
skill_put: Store a new or fully-rewritten skill; identical body is a no-op.
skill_update: Append a revision note to a skill; never rewrites history.
skill_install: Import a skill from skills.sh or GitHub, then store it.
bootstrap: Combined session opener: orientation + top memories + skill index. Load once per conversation.
